method: SuperMimic differentiable world model, imagined actor BPTT, critic
source_group_policy: Original motion ID and its mirrored or cropped derivatives stay in one split; cross-source overlaps quarantined before mixture

evaluation.physics: MuJoCo, free base, no external support, closed-loop policy
evaluation.protocol: Whole clip at native time; fixed initial origin and heading; no per-frame alignment; early failure is failure
evaluation.threshold_origin: Project engineering acceptance, not a claim of the paper's exact evaluation threshold

limits: Goal and planned budgets, not a registered or started training run. Native source format, exact input SHA, reference gates and runtime resource protection must pass before training. No full H100-scale paper-compute equivalence is claimed.
